decisions.question: How should claude-setup ask about enforcing each plugin?

options.label: Grouped pages
options.summary: One AskUserQuestion call with 4 grouped questions (enforce, delivery mode, CI, other setups). Done offers are left out.

options.label: One question per plugin
options.summary: A question for each of the 8 plugins and each other setup, over several pages.

decisions.question: Which delivery mode should a project start in?

options.label: Ask, warn preselected
options.summary: The owner picks. Warn is preselected, so a new project is not blocked on day one.

options.label: Ask, block preselected
options.summary: The owner picks. Block is preselected.

options.label: Always block
options.summary: No question. Block from the start.

decisions.question: Should claude-setup write a CI workflow for the docs, design-system and spec checks?

options.label: Yes, in claude-setup
options.summary: claude-setup writes .github/workflows/dev-standards.yml and prints the branch-protection command.

options.label: Hand to tech-stack-setup
options.summary: claude-setup only offers tech-stack-setup, which owns CI files.

decisions.question: Should the docs Stop hook be able to block?

options.label: Warn only, block in CI
options.summary: Keep today's warning. The required CI check is the block.

options.label: Opt-in block
options.summary: A docs.json setting turns the warning into a block, with a 3-block ceiling.

decisions.question: Three paths can write a feature spec (specs spec-new, docs feature-spec-new, artifacts promote-to-spec). How should they split?

options.label: Split by kind
options.summary: spec-new writes only specs that are not features (standards, migrations, services). luismc-docs feature-spec-new writes every feature spec. promote-to-spec stays the one link from a feature page to its spec. Only skill descriptions and the hand-off text change.

options.label: Keep as is
options.summary: spec-new keeps handing feature specs to feature-spec-new in a DOCSPEC repo; nothing changes.

options.label: Merge spec-new into luismc-docs
options.summary: Move spec-new into the docs plugin; luismc-specs keeps only spec-check.

decisions.question: Where should transcript-folds be installed and turned on?

options.label: Project level
options.summary: Install and enable it per project like the other seven; only the two chords stay in ~/.claude/keybindings.json.

options.label: Keep user level
options.summary: Keep the exception: on in every project.

decisions.question: Where should claude-setup write its config files (rules, CLAUDE.md, statusline, output style, effort hook, model split) by default?

options.label: Project by default
options.summary: Write them into the project's .claude/ by default; user level only when picked. Existing ~/.claude copies stay.

options.label: Project, remove mine
options.summary: Same, and remove the copies in ~/.claude on this PC now.

options.label: Keep user level
options.summary: Change only where plugins are installed.

decisions.question: Should claude-setup register the dev-standards marketplace in each project?

options.label: Add per project
options.summary: Write extraKnownMarketplaces.dev-standards into each project's settings; the user-level entry stays.

options.label: User level only
options.summary: Each new machine runs claude plugin marketplace add once.
